payload.name: ExtractEachDistinctStatement
payload.description: Use during construction extraction when a single message contains multiple distinct statements—such as a plan or invitation plus a separate intention or hypothetical activity—and each needs its own memory candidate.
content: During candidate extraction, emit a separate candidate for each distinct durable fact in a message. If a message states both a concrete plan/invitation and a separate personal intention or hypothetical activity (e.g., a joke about pursuing a creative project), create one candidate for each rather than only the most prominent fact. Stop when every distinct fact is covered; do not split rephrasings, elaborations, or supporting details of the same fact.

solves: Extraction drops a secondary durable fact when a message already yields a more prominent one, leaving memory incomplete. Apply when a single message states both a plan/invitation and a separate intention or hypothetical activity (e.g., a joke about a future creative project); emit a separate candidate for each. Do not apply when the secondary text only elaborates the primary fact or when only one distinct fact exists.
